# Mixer

The `*mixer*` buffer holds one strip per track with **level**, **pan** and
send knobs. [Open it now](action:switch-to-buffer "*mixer*") or press
`C-x b *mixer*`.

## Groups

Tracks can be grouped Ableton-style. A group strip sums its members and
carries its own effects chain, so a whole drum kit can share one
compressor.

Back to the [Sequencer Tour](sequencer-tour) or the [top](index).
